title: Bio
mainTitle: I focus on creating great, accessible and rich web experiences for everyone. I've been lucky enough to have been doing that for the last 15 years.
description: When I’m not working, I’m a radio host who loves heading to festivals and gigs, diving into the amazing world of craft beers, and getting in a workout at the gym whenever possible. I also cherish spending quality time with my wife and son.

picture.alt: A grid collage featuring João Dias in a delightful series of escapades: beaming beside his wife like they’ve just won a lifetime supply of coffee, looking dramatically intense in the studio as if recording the next big hit, clutching a leather jacket like it’s the crown jewel of his wardrobe, basking in the countryside with the air of a man who just befriended a sheep, and broadcasting a radio show with the unmistakable confidence of someone who believes every listener is hanging on his every word.
